turns.t: Hiya. I've, er, I've got a mole on my back that my sister says looks different.
Right. Tell me about it, what's changed?
Well, I can't see it myself, my sister spotted it at the swimming baths. She says it's bigger and a bit darker than it was.
Has anything changed that you've noticed, itching, bleeding, crusting?
It does itch a bit, now I think about it. Only recently, the last two weeks.
When did your sister first notice the change?
She said it was a few months back she first noticed, but I'd not taken any notice.
Is it the only one, or are there others you're concerned about? ~
Just that one. I've got loads of freckles, but nothing else looks like it. ~
Okay. Have you any skin conditions I should know about?
I had eczema as a kid, behind my knees. Not now.
Right. Let me look. Can you take your top off, and turn around? ~
Er, yes. Sorry, it's a bit cold in here. ~
It's fine. Just let me find the one you mean.
It's low down on the left, near my waist. ~
Yes, I see it. I'm going to use this dermatoscope, it's a magnifier with a light.
Is it painful? ~
Not at all. It just sits on the skin. ~
Okay. ~
Right. It's about seven millimetres across and the colour isn't even, there's a darker area at one edge, and the border's slightly irregular. ~
Is that bad? ~
Those are the features we pay attention to. Most moles like this turn out to be harmless, I'd say this is likely a benign mole, but because it has changed and itches, I can't be certain.
So what happens now? ~
I'd like to take a dermoscopy photograph of it today, and send it to the skin specialists so they can look at it properly.
Will they cut it out? ~
They may want to take it off, to be safe, and then look at it under a microscope. They'll decide. ~
Oh. Right. ~
It's a minor procedure with a local anaesthetic, and you'd be home the same day. ~
I'm a bit worried now. ~
It's normal to be worried, but I'd rather we look at it now than wait. ~
When will I hear? ~
Within two weeks, you'll get a letter. If it changes again, bleeds, or you haven't heard in two weeks, ring us.
I will. Thanks very much. ~
Take care. ~
